Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-rays show a massive right-sided pneumothorax/hydropneumothorax with the cardiac silhouette displaced into the right hemithorax, which is characteristic of right-sided cardiac herniation through a pericardial defect following surgery for right-sided mesothelioma. This mechanical displacement causes acute haemodynamic compromise (obstruction and torsion), distinguishing it from simple tamponade or tension pneumothorax alone.
